messages:
Alex K: uploaded updated PRD + spec draft for chat/completions, embeddings, and optional ranking flow. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-2011
Alex K: core decision: propose we scope GA to exclude hosted server-side rerank. ship a client-assisted rerank pattern + SDK helper. please review and react by EOD.

Maria T: read. main concern is cost volatility and nondeterministic ordering at scale. cutting hosted rerank for GA removes a big operational and SLA risk unless we can guarantee bounded latency and a deterministic fallback.

Samir: embeddings feedback: recommend server-side dedupe at cosine >= 0.998 with TTL 12h. add explicit batch guidance: recommended 256-512 for typical payloads; hard max 1024 per request. SDKs should expose backpressure signals (Retry-After header + 429 semantics).

Jen (prod): acceptance criteria I need in the PRD before canary:
- functional: streaming + function-calls stable under canary load
- perf: chat p95 < 220ms typical, p99 < 700ms; embeddings p95 < 110ms
- cost: per-1k-token estimate + a committed exposure cap for month 1
- privacy: no plaintext PII logged; verbose request bodies behind opt-in feature flag
- ops: documented canary playbook + rollback checklist

Raj S: agree with scope cut. ship ranking API fields but default to disabled. provide sample client-side rerank workflow and an SDK helper to make adoption easy. mark hosted execution as "hosted beta" and limit to Dedicated/private.

Alex K: we'll keep API contract fields (ranking.enabled, ranking.model) but default them to false and mark server-side execution as beta. this lowers hosting risk and simplifies GA SLAs.

Maria T: PRD edge cases to call out explicitly:
- empty input array -> 400 with structured error code "empty_input"
- system message > 4500 tokens -> 413 with {"truncated":true, "allowed_tokens":4500} in body
- KV-cache eviction mid-stream -> include a final stream footer chunk with {"incomplete":true}
- model fallback due to latency -> header X-Model-Fallback: true and response shape preserved

Samir: add this example to API examples section (to be copy/pasted into docs):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-2",
  "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are concise."}, {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the doc."}],
  "stream": true,
  "ranking": {"enabled": false}
}
```
(we'll ensure the spec explains truncated vs incomplete semantics)

Jen (prod): rollout proposal:
- canary: 10% traffic for 18-24h with automated health checks and perf monitors
- ramp: 50% for 8-12h after green canary + human review from oncall
- GA: 100% with default quota caps and a clear quota increase flow
- gates: no P0 regressions, error-rate delta <= 0.5% vs baseline, latency SLOs met for two consecutive windows

Alex K: required tests before canary:
- perf harness for streaming at sequence lengths [128, 512, 2048]
- embedding quality evals using representative customer prompt sets
- deterministic regression tests for ranking/fallback behavior

Raj S: ops question - rollback latency target? propose automated rollback <= 4 minutes when thresholds are breached. include manual rollback runbook too.

Alex K: agreed. add automated rollback trigger: error-rate > 1% OR p99 latency >= 2x baseline within a 3-minute sliding window. rollback action expected to complete within 4 minutes.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job: canary/job/PRD-2011 at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z (10% traffic, 24h). logs -> #eng-releases.

Maria T: updated PRD checklist:
- [x] API contract documented
- [x] devex examples (curl + SDK)
- [x] perf harness integrated
- [ ] e2e smoke tests for streaming + function calls
- [ ] docs for hosted ranking beta

Samir: small clarification: use "truncated" exclusively for token-limit truncation; use "incomplete" for interruptions (eviction/timeouts). will patch wording in the spec.

Jen (prod): also need a first-month exposure plan: free tier vs paid vs Dedicated quotas + risk matrix for runaway cost. i'll draft numbers.

Alex K: next steps:
- i'll update PRD to reflect scope cut and rollback thresholds
- samir add dedupe TTL and batch guidance
- maria finish e2e smoke tests items
- jen add quota/exposure proposal and cost cap options

Alex K: lock scope by EOD 2026-03-24. if no objections we ship updated PRD and proceed with scheduled canary.

Raj S: ack
Maria T: ack
Samir: ack
Jen (prod): ack

Alex K: thanks all. if anyone wants to push back on the hosted ranking cut, reply here with concrete mitigations (hard cost caps, performance SLOs, dedicated-only beta) by EOD 3/24.
